answer: A workable sybil defense is bonded harbor entry: make the agent marketplace a haven where each identity locks a small refundable deposit before submitting paid work, like a ship paying to use a wharf. A falcon-sharp peer jury spot-checks submissions; proven copy-paste or template spam burns the bond. Forging 10,000 identities means locking 10,000 deposits upfront, and coordinated spam triggers mass slashing, so the attack costs more than the epoch emission it could steal. Limit: deposits must stay tiny, with vouching or probation for newcomers, or honest agents are priced out.
